ideas.pitch: A decentralized delivery drone dispatch network where autonomous robotics trigger micro-payments via MST Blockchain upon verified package drop-off.
ideas.title: MST Autonomous Micropayment Drone Relay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core expertise of both co-organizers: MST Blockchain and Newrro's robotics focus. By combining autonomous edge hardware with on-chain payments, it addresses the exact synergy judges will look for.

ideas.pitch: An IoT mesh network of smart agriculture sensors powered by Newrro robotics principles, utilizing decentralized physical infrastructure networks (DePIN) and an on-chain autonomous AI agent to flag anomalies.
ideas.title: DePIN Agri-Sensor Mesh with LLM Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages DePIN and AI Agents—two major themes highlighted in the hackathon brief—while incorporating edge data logging suitable for offline demonstration.

ideas.pitch: Zero-knowledge proof verification pipeline ensuring autonomous factory inspection robots only transmit decrypted sensor diagnostics to authorized wallet holders on MST Blockchain.
ideas.title: ZK-Gated Autonomous Robotic Inspection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced cryptographic primitives with hardware systems, standing out among standard web apps by demonstrating deep systems engineering.

ideas.pitch: A consumer payment gateway built on MST Blockchain integrated with an AI agent that automatically executes DeFi yield strategies on unused loyalty cashbacks.
ideas.title: MST Consumer Payment & Autonomous Cashback Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Consumer payments and DeFi are explicitly named in the prompt's track guidelines; judges favor polished apps that solve a practical retail transaction use case.

ideas.pitch: Tokenized industrial robotic arms on MST Blockchain that allow fractional RWA ownership and automated lease execution based on machine telemetry.
ideas.title: Real-World Asset (RWA) Automated Robotics Leasing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges the RWA narrative with Newrro's industrial robotics background, ticking multiple boxes for the organizing entities.
